title: Q13 actual active-session content update feasibility
scope: Read-only repository/source and existing compiled-bundle review. The compiled bundle was inspected read-only; no device, service, private process environment, account, runtime state, source, or configuration was inspected or changed.

decision.reason: The current compiled v24 runtime cannot update its statically bundled OOD track in place, and no OOD node offer exists. However, local history contains accepted v23 and v24 OOD app/content identities with the same app bundle identifier and existing local build/install path, so a real same-app active-session update test is technically available without a new candidate; it has not been run.
decision.localUpdateTestStatus: Feasible path identified; no build or install performed in this read-only preflight.

existingMechanisms.canonicalTrack: runtimeCatalog statically imports generated track artifacts and content lock and caches the canonical catalog. contentPackageRuntimeOwner.verifyBundledPackages verifies the bundled catalog. resolveExactArtifact resolves only a matching exact artifact from the current bundle or retained installed node packages; it does not substitute latest content for a session pin.
existingMechanisms.activeSession: Training session item references include trackId, contentVersion, and artifactSha256. Resume resolves the exact identity. Bootstrap verifies the available package, then resolves the active session. A previously recorded unavailable-active-session record exposes the explicit abandon flow; a direct exact-artifact resume failure instead reaches the blocking bootstrap error. Neither path migrates the session.
existingMechanisms.premiumNodeInstaller: installPremiumNodeOffer accepts an available offer, retrieves a node payload through the authenticated API or smoke transport, verifies exact identity, stores immutable package bytes, activates the profile-scoped package pointer, and registers that node runtime. This is node-scoped Premium content, not the bundled full OOD track.
existingMechanisms.currentPremiumOffers: Metro selects premiumNodeOffers.smoke.ts for PATTERNLY_RUNTIME_MODE=smoke and premiumNodeOffers.disabled.ts otherwise. The inspected compiled bundle embeds EXPO_PUBLIC_PATTERNLY_RUNTIME_MODE=smoke and the smoke module. That module exposes one local_smoke_fixture AWS offer (aud04_local_smoke_fixture, aud04-local-fixture-v1) containing one choice_single question. The device-local test key makes that local offer available only in smoke mode. The non-smoke registry is empty and its local transport returns null. No OOD full-track or OOD node offer exists. Reinstalling the fixed same-version AWS fixture is not evidence of a newer-package update.
existingMechanisms.updateDelivery: syncBundledContentRelease validates/writes generated canonical artifacts and content lock as build/release inputs. Release app config disables Expo Updates and automatic checking. No app call to Expo update check/fetch/reload APIs was found.

feasibility.reason: The inspected bundle carries the OOD v24 artifact and one fixed AWS local smoke node package. Reinstalling the same aud04-local-fixture-v1 package would not demonstrate a newer identity or update an OOD active session. A JavaScript reload without a newly delivered OOD bundle would still load the same bundled OOD artifact. Editing local source, profile storage, or session references would not demonstrate an actual admitted package update.
feasibility.whatWouldBeNeededForFutureTest: Build/install the accepted v23 app/content revision on the existing simulator, create and preserve a real v23-pinned active OOD session, then build/install the accepted v24 revision over the same app identity and verify app data preservation plus exact-session resume/unavailable behavior. This uses existing accepted versions and the already-authorized local build/install path; it does not require a new candidate. No such sequence was run in this preflight.
feasibility.availableEvidenceNow: Accepted v23 and v24 OOD artifact identities are present in local app Git history and their package QA receipts; both app revisions use the same iOS bundle identifier and npm run ios:smoke command. The current v24 smoke bundle was inspected earlier. This establishes technical availability of a sequential local test, not that app data survived an installation or that active-session behavior passed.

noActionTaken: No source, generated artifact, content lock, service configuration, device, profile, account, session, or app state changed.
No package update, app build/install, publication, candidate creation, service call, seeded session, or JavaScript reload was attempted.

profileSpecificEvidence.profileSelection: npm run start:smoke sets both PATTERNLY_RUNTIME_MODE and EXPO_PUBLIC_PATTERNLY_RUNTIME_MODE to smoke; Metro aliases the premium offers import to premiumNodeOffers.smoke.ts for that mode. The inspected bundle is compiled with public runtime mode smoke; it is not proof of a currently running device build.

compiledBundle.observed: Embeds public runtime mode smoke and module src/content/application/premiumNodeOffers.smoke.ts. This is bundle evidence only, not proof of the currently installed/running device build.

profileSpecificEvidence.conclusion: The smoke offer can exercise install/activation of its fixed AWS node fixture when the device-local test key is enabled. It cannot establish a newer package identity or update the OOD full track or an OOD node.

sameAppInstall.commandPath: scripts/runLocalProfile.mjs smoke ios -> npx expo run:ios -> Expo CLI AppleDeviceManager.installAppAsync -> simctl install
sameAppInstall.dataPreservationEvidence: Same-ID iOS app updates preserve app container per Apple Developer Technical Support; this specific v23-to-v24 app-data/session preservation has not been exercised.

codingV03ToCurrentV04.scope: Read-only repository history/source feasibility; no build, app install, device inspection, session creation, or storage mutation.

historicalV03.evidence: The app release lock and bundled generatedArtifacts module carry the same release/checksum. The content producer build-report.json at producer commit records the source commit, contentVersion, checksum, and itemCount.

currentAvailableInstallCommands: npm run ios:smoke -> scripts/runLocalProfile.mjs smoke ios -> expo run:ios
sameAppIdentityAndInstall.installImplementation: Expo AppleDeviceManager uses simctl install and does not explicitly uninstall before install.
sameAppIdentityAndInstall.dataPreservation: Same-bundle-ID iOS updates are documented by Apple DTS as the same app; survival of this Patternly session/profile across these specific builds has not been tested.
sameAppIdentityAndInstall.smokeApiRelevance: Free N01 is bundled; smoke API and the single AWS Premium fixture are not required for Coding and cannot evidence a Coding package update.

persistenceCompatibility.storageNamespaceAndEnvelope: Both generations use patternly:canonical:v1 keys and patternly:canonical:v1 record envelopes; metadata schemaVersion remains 1.

currentTrainingSession.guard: isTrainingSession uses an exact top-level key set and strict resolved-content-ref shape.

persistenceCompatibility.migration: openCanonicalRepositories validates metadata and provisions the guest; no v03 session shape conversion is present. The current metadata validator retains schemaVersion 1 and does not migrate an old session payload.
persistenceCompatibility.sourcePredictedOutcome: A v03 active session record fails the current exact guard during readCanonicalEnvelope/readCanonicalJson with UnsupportedStoredRecordError. It cannot reach exact-artifact resolution or the explicit unavailable-active-session/abandon flow, absent a migration not found in the inspected source.
persistenceCompatibility.observationStatus: Source-level prediction only; no persisted session was read and no actual launch/update was attempted.

currentCodeWithHistoricalV03Artifact.behavior: The synchronizer builds from the supplied producer checkout current source and validates the current nine-track, 16,077-question inventory. It has no argument selecting a historical per-track artifact or historical release-lock row.
currentCodeWithHistoricalV03Artifact.conclusion: The v03 artifact is present in the historical app bundle and producer history, but no supported current-code historical-v03 bundle substitution path was found. Manually replacing current generated artifact files would not be an admitted build; no such substitution was attempted.

steps: Build/install the historically bundled v03 app without uninstalling.
Use ordinary Free N01 UI to start a real Coding session and leave it active; do not seed or edit storage.
Install the accepted current v04 app over the same app identity.
Launch and record whether exact session resume succeeds or which existing recovery/blocking path is shown.
smallestUsefulSameInstallProbe.expectedByCurrentSource: The current guard is expected to block while reading the old session schema, before content-identity fallback.
smallestUsefulSameInstallProbe.acceptanceGap: If the intended result is successful resume or the explicit unavailable-content flow, the inspected current code has no migration from the v03 persisted shape. Resolve that concrete compatibility behavior before describing the probe as a passing update/resume test.

distinction.contentCatalog: N01 is the configured free-node content pool: mode selection is node-scoped to N01 and the pool has 136 items in the accepted v23/v24 pair.
distinction.sessionAdmission: The content profile does not make ordinary OOD sessions Free. requiresPremiumProductMode returns true for every isDesignInterviewModeId; PracticeHubScreen calls authorizePremiumSessionStart before navigating to setup; TrainingLifecycleUseCases.startSession authorizes before preparation. PracticeSetupScreen also rejects non-Design modes for a Design track.
distinction.coverage: The unchanged premiumProductModeLifecycle test enumerates all four Design IDs, including simulation, and verifies denial occurs before package resolution, preparation, or session mutation. The three ordinary N01 modes are therefore Premium-gated despite their freeNodeId pool selection.
distinction.result: An ordinary Free OOD N01 active session cannot be created through the current normal UI/lifecycle path on either accepted app revision without Premium authorization. The same-schema v23-to-v24 bundle pair remains a technically valid update candidate only if a legitimate Design-session entitlement is available. The AWS-only smoke offer is not evidence of Design-mode admission.
distinction.limitations: This is a source/configuration finding, not a device or entitlement-service observation. No entitlement toggle was exercised, and no service/configuration change is proposed.
